actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/git.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/git.purpose: Inspect or change Git repository state.

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@cli/shell.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/shell.note: Resolve to the session shell (PowerShell, bash or another declared shell); do not assume bash on Windows. Arguments remain separate data until encoded for that shell.
@cli/shell.purpose: Run a declared command in the active session shell.

@tools/browsercontrol.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/browsercontrol.purpose: Drive a real browser against a served route: navigate, act, capture screenshots and DOM measurements.

claude.via: mode required: the in-app Browser pane, or Claude in Chrome when the task needs the person's sessions

openai.via: mode required: Codex computer use, which opens the person's own Chrome, on a dedicated browser profile (the shared UAT identity), never the person's logged-in profile

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/imagegen.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/imagegen.purpose: Produce artwork: a digital image from an image model, made to one stated claim. Rendering HTML is the visualize tool, not this one.

claude.via: none; a judged step records that no artwork could be made and the branch continues; a required step blocks with the operator's own code

openai.via: the OpenAI image model available to the Codex session

@tools/imageview.bind: Image inspection capability advertised by the active session; inspect actual pixels, not filenames or metadata.
@tools/imageview.purpose: Inspect image pixels through session image input or an image viewing tool.

claude.via: Attached images or an image-capable file reader.

openai.via: Attached images or an available image viewing tool.

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@tools/visualize.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/visualize.purpose: Create a visual explanation or preview through the active session; record any produced files as outputs.

claude.via: files written by the Claude Code session

openai.via: files written by the Codex session

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/context.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/context.purpose: Supporting reference files for a request.

@workspaces/fe.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/fe.purpose: The explicitly bound frontend checkout; unavailable when the project has no frontend role.

@workspaces/grammar.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/grammar.purpose: The explicitly resolved grammar package directory; unavailable when no grammar package is bound.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/knowledge.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/knowledge.purpose: Knowledge published by the selected skill runtime.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

@workspaces/work.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/work.purpose: One work record and its associated files.

criteria.stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion and criteriaResults entry passes for current outputs. Stop after two feedback rounds or an unchanged repeated failure; unavailable capability blocks and missing essential input asks.

purpose: Generate one bounded frontend surface from supplied product authority, visual references and the published UI system, render it, inspect it, and commit the accepted source.

request.description: inputs.prompts define the target, product behavior, viewport set, mutable and protected source paths, UI-system bindings and proof commands. inputs.files contain authoritative plans or supplied artwork. context.visual is explicit: extend/revise requires the exact selected baseline in context.files and preserve/change instructions; new is valid only for a genuinely new direction.
request.title: interface.generate request

response.description: A done response identifies the accepted rendered capture, its direction and resolution records, the source commit and actual render proof.
response.title: interface.generate response

scope: One declared frontend surface and mutable owner ceiling. It may create or revise application source and request-scoped visual assets. It does not invent product behavior, edit shared UI authority, publish, merge, deploy, or claim acceptance from source inspection alone.

calls.purpose: Read only declared product, source and UI authority.

calls.when: context.visual mode is extend or revise

steps.instruction: Read the request, behavior authority, current source, UI-system references and visual context. Freeze target, states, content, viewports, mutable/protected paths and proof commands. For extend/revise, inspect and bind the exact selected baseline; ask if absent rather than choosing new.
produces: A frozen surface, visual inheritance and source boundary.

reads.when: when authority or assets are declared
when a grammar package is bound

calls.purpose: Create requested artwork using actual bound visual references.
calls.when: only when the surface requires generated artwork

calls.purpose: Persist direction, resolution and accepted asset records.

steps.instruction: Form the smallest viable direction from product authority and the published UI system. Resolve every application-owned value, record preserved and changed regions, and create artwork only for a specific requested visual claim. Pass actual reference images to image generation; never replace an existing design with unrelated art.

reads.when: context.visual mode is extend or revise

calls.purpose: Implement the resolved tree inside the mutable frontend ceiling.
Render the implemented surface at declared viewports.
Exercise declared interactive states and capture actual rendered output.
calls.when: when interaction or browser evidence is required

calls.purpose: Run only declared source and behavior checks.

steps.instruction: Write only declared frontend paths, render each required state at every viewport, and capture actual pixels. Run declared source and interaction checks unchanged. Do not call source complete until the rendered result exists.

writes.when: after direction and resolution are frozen

calls.purpose: Inspect actual baseline and rendered pixels together.
Apply targeted source repairs, remove rejected image deliverables and write response metadata.
Measure the final diff and create one local source commit.
Validate the compiled request and response.

steps.instruction: Inspect the baseline and rendered pixels, source diff and raw proof. Turn every failure into concrete feedback, repair only the owning region, delete rejected image deliverables, rerender affected states and reassess. Commit once and write a response only after every criterion accepts the current outputs.

reads.when: context.visual mode is extend or revise

validate.failurePolicy: Produce, render, inspect and provide concrete findings. Repair only the failed source region or asset, rerender affected viewports and reassess. Delete rejected image deliverables while keeping concise failure metadata and accepted outputs.

review.instruction: Compare the rendered surface with supplied behavior, content, states and acceptance criteria. Reject invented claims, missing actions and behavior inferred without authority.

Inspect actual baseline and result pixels together. For extend or revise, preserve the selected shell, navigation, palette, typography and unchanged regions; reject an unrelated redesign or a candidate based only on filename or memory.
Inspect source and rendered output against the bound UI system and application-owned value inventory. Reject private anatomy selectors, invented tokens and edits to shared authority.

Inspect every declared viewport and required state for hierarchy, readability, overflow, accessibility, interaction and visual quality. Source intent and a synthetic fixture do not prove rendered acceptance.
Inspect the actual diff and commit. Require every changed path inside the mutable owner ceiling and outside protected paths, with no publish, merge or runtime reconfiguration.
